entity.name: Prodigy Commerce, Inc.
entity.description:
Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

Prodigy’s solution eliminates the complexity, security risks, and costs of WooCommerce’s plugin and extension architecture by tightly integrating all essential functionality, and natively building premium features, into the platform. Integration partners include ShipEngine, TaxJar, MaxMind minFraud, high-quality payment processors, Google Analytics, and Facebook Pixel. Natively built premium features currently include abandoned cart recovery and the ability to sell products and services on a subscription basis. No third-party services are needed to build fully functional stores.

Prodigy’s business model is based solely upon revenue sharing agreements with the payment processors integrated into its platform, similar to Shopify’s exclusive relationship with payments’ facilitator Stripe. Prodigy, however, does not charge a subscription or app fees; it really is free. Payment processing rates start at the standard 2.9% + $0.30. For high-volume stores, Prodigy helps store owners negotiate lower rates and fees. Prodigy is perfectly aligned with a store owner’s primary goal, generating sales.

| Payments - Native support for card, cash-on-delivery, and instant IPS QR payments.
| Compliance - Auto-generated invoices and full fiscalization support for Serbia.
| AI Agents - Handle marketing automation, inventory alerts, customer support, and personalization.
| Fulfillment Ready - Optional warehousing and fulfillment, Mozhe’s FBA-style service.

Merchants get an advanced admin dashboard with live AI chat help, tools for promo codes, cart recovery, analytics, and more - all locally optimized and ready out of the box.

Mozhe is the fastest way for small retailers, solopreneurs, and local shops to digitize their business without friction or complexity. Whether you’re upgrading from selling through Instagram or stepping beyond Shopify’s limitations, Mozhe gives you the power of enterprise commerce in a tool built for local scale.

Simple. Local. Automated. That’s Mozhe.

Our team is a mix of people who helped build Amazon's print-on-demand business, designers, developers, and creatives across the United States, India, Canada, and Europe.

Talent is everywhere. Opportunity isn't. We're here to change that.
